title: Standup ready
description: Walk into standup with specific progress, today's priorities, blockers, and supporting context.

blocks.title: Standup note
blocks.intent: Write a concise standup update from the last 24 hours with completed progress, current work, next priorities, and blockers. Keep claims source-backed.

blocks.title: What I worked on
blocks.intent: List concrete work and outcomes observed in the last 24 hours, prioritizing finished or meaningfully advanced items.

blocks.title: What is next
blocks.intent: List the most likely next work items based on explicit plans, unfinished work, and upcoming commitments from the last 24 hours.

blocks.title: Blockers
blocks.intent: List explicit blockers or repeated friction from the last 24 hours. Do not label ordinary unfinished work as blocked without evidence.

blocks.title: Supporting context
blocks.intent: Show timestamped events from the last 24 hours that provide useful supporting context for the standup update.
